competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, apply only to a special promotion, or be confused with an exchange, store-credit, or category-specific return policy.

refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows a different return window for standard items, or no full-refund entitlement within 30 days.
